Groundwater quality data for the state of Ohio

Source: R/data.R
ohio_data.Rd

A dataset containing groundwater quality data for the state of Ohio.

Usage

ohio_data

Format

A data frame with 213845 rows and 47 variables:

well_id

well_id, Site Identifier

result_value

analytical result

analyte_count
analyte_group
analyte_id
casing_length
charge_balance_error
chemistry_sheet_id
collection_timestamp
collector_gwqcp_person_id
comb_result
county
detect_limit_unit
detect_limit_value
detected_count
district
field_comments
field_qc_type
geo_age
geo_setting
is_filtered
lab_comments
lab_comments.1
latitude
lith_open_section
local_name
longitude
major_lithology
matrix_type
method
name
name.1
original_sheet_id
parameter
pws_id
remark_code
result_unit
sample_id
sample_type
sampling_status
site_id
status
user_comments
well_depth
well_id_code
well_log_num
well_number

Source

http://epa.ohio.gov/ddagw/gwqcp.aspx
